answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 44066 Country: India Title: wudhu Question: My question pertains to wudhu before salah. I want to ask that if I perform my wudhu half at home and half after going to the mosque immediately will it be valid? And also my another question is that how many maximum salah can I offer with a single wudhu supposing the fact that in the course of time nothing such thing has been done to nullify or break the wudhu. I will be highly obliged if answered soon. Answer ID: 44066 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 397/L-176/TL=1434) (1) Wudhu shall be valid and correct if half wudhu was done at home and half in the mosque but doing wudhu continuously to an extent that one part is washed before the previous part dries is sunnah. Hence in this case if before reaching the mosque first part dries then it shall be missing sunnah act. (2) You may offer as much salah as you wish with a wudhu until nothing happens which breaks wudhu. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
